reviews.x: I was very cautious about purchasing oils online but I'm very glad I have this one a try. Though the smell is not my favorite the results are so worth it. My face and hands are softer. I've also started adding it into my hair to make it shiny. My reason for purchasing it originally though was format stretch marks. I just delivered my third baby a few weeks ago and needed to work on getting rid of those lines!! I've noticed my skin is softer and the lines aren't as dark!!! Yay!!!

reviews.t: High marks!
reviews.x: my name is Linda and I love the rosehip seed oil, it has made my skin smoother, and evened out blotchy skin discolorations, People have commented on how much brighter my skin is. I don't even wear foundation any more . I don't need it. Rosehip seed oil has become a part of my daily routine and I love it.

reviews.t: A Little Goes A Long Way!
reviews.x: First of all, this is a generous amount of rosehip oil! I've been using it daily for about 2 weeks and I've barely put a dent in it. I've been using it on a burn scar that I have on my arm. The pump lid is easy to use & dispenses a nice amount of oil. One pump is enough for my scar. When I first used it, I was a little concerned, because it comes out a golden color, but when you rub it in, the color completely disappears. It does not leave my hands feeling greasy, which is very important to me.

reviews.t: This is a great product for helping with dry skin
reviews.x: This is a great product for helping with dry skin, diminishing scars and stretch marks, and has helped me regain control of the eczema on the palms of my hands.  My skin is softer and it has helped to diminish stretch marks on my stomach after having 3 babies in less than 5 years.  The palms of my hands look better and are no longer itchy anymore.  I am happy to have the eczema under control again on my hands.  My son recently had surgery and after only 4 days the scar has faded on his stomach.

reviews.x: It's a good thing this comes in a good size bottle because I am using it from the tips of my toes to the hair on my head! reviews.t: Rosehip Seed Oil for Soft Skin.
reviews.x: I have used thr Jaroas rosehip seed oil for about three weeks now.  I am writing to review because I am amazed at how soft and creamy my skin has become. It seems the age or sun spots on my hands are lighter.  It will take more time to verify that for sure. I just know that my skin is definately softer.

reviews.t: Great natural moisturizer
reviews.x: I got this as a gift for my mom and we are both really impressed by this rosehip seed oil. She has dry skin and brittle, dry hair so I wanted to find a multi purpose moisturizer for her and I found one! It really moisturizes her face and neck and helps to smooth out her hair. She says she likes the feel of it and is looking forward to using it every day! I like that it is all natural and she's not subjecting her skin to a bunch of chemicals

reviews.t: Fantastic product

Use on elbows, knees, feet & hair.

reviews.t: Very Nice
reviews.x: This is a really nice quality oil.  It has a deep rich color, the correct soft earthy smell and it absorbs well into the skin.  I keep mine in the refrigerator and transfer small amounts into another bottle so the oil stays fresh.  Rosehip Seed oil can go rancid faster than other carrier oils and this has kept the oil well for over a year. A good oil should have a red/orange color to it and this certainly does.

reviews.t: Great for soothing hands!

The oil pumps out in the perfect portion size for my hands, and it keeps my hands silky and hydrated without being oily or greasy. This oil truly deserves 5 stars! Thank you!

reviews.t: Nice hands and face even in harsh dry winter conditions.

reviews.t: It worked amazing on my face
reviews.x: I have using Jarosa Pure Rosehip Seed Oil for three weeks. I have used it on my face and also as a moisturizer on my legs. It worked amazing on my face, taking care of impurities and evening out my skin. It soothed my dry skin on my legs. It also held the moisture so my skin did not dry out as fast.. I would recommend this product to anyone who has scars or that has chronic dry skin..

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the oil for moisturizing dry skin and making skin softer, including on the face, hands, and elbows.
Many reviewers report improvements in scars, stretch marks, discoloration, and skin tone or radiance.
Several reviewers value that the product is organic, cold pressed, and reasonably priced for its quality.
A few reviewers mention the smell is not pleasant or that the oil was rancid.
Some reviewers note the oil is rich and a little goes a long way, though one mentions oils not rubbing in fully.
